evidence: ConnectorContractTests and ConnectorPortTests prove immutable public-schema roundtrip and mockable async composition for all five scientific operation shapes. Every result binds request/provider and explicit observation/retrieval and page terms states, including empty/failed pages; records retain actual raw identifiers, namespaced fields and separate license/terms observations. Normalized errors and strict provenance/outcome/cursor/cache relationships remain separate from rights or egress grants.

The 18 connector tests cover invalid operation/configuration/identifier, scientific project/version/query substitution, advancing/expired/cross-project cursors, cache page identity/freshness, terminal denial/cancellation, forged nested models, strict UTC, resource limits, malformed JSON, retention and provenance contradictions. Two first-review regressions replay F01 noncanonical direct resume time and F02 empty/failed page terms at this exact candidate.

Three versioned standalone generated JSON Schemas, immutable owned Core values, dependency-neutral Protocol ports, explicitly synthetic CC0 fixture, architecture documentation and build/quality inventories are delivered. Exact schema generation, 3 existing generator-contract regressions, affected lint/format/types, architecture, build inventory and backlog projection checks pass. No migration, persisted predecessor, network call, new API route, dependency, UI change, parallel identity store or runtime authorization claim is introduced.
